consequence.statement: Operators who configured -boltdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix or -tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix (or the corresponding YAML setting) to a value other than index/ must set path_prefix on all existing period configs that use boltdb-shipper or tsdb as the index, to the previously configured value; this is presented as a required configuration step of the Loki 3.0.0 upgrade (the shared_store/shared_store_key_prefix shipper settings were removed).
consequence.remediation: Set path_prefix to the previously configured key-prefix value on every existing period config whose index is boltdb-shipper or tsdb.

original.statement: Upgrading to Loki 3.0.0 requires operators who set -boltdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix or -tsdb.shipper.shared-store.key-prefix (or the corresponding YAML setting) to a value other than index/ to set path_prefix on all existing period configs that use boltdb-shipper or tsdb as the index, to the value previously configured.

decision.reason: [ev-43cc6d389282] says the boltdb and tsdb shipper key-prefix flags and their YAML settings are removed in 3.0.0, and that the path prefix for the index is now set with `path_prefix` under the period config's `index` key. [ev-8ceba924ad20] and [ev-632a3911583a] tell operators who set the prefix to anything other than `index/` to set `path_prefix` to their old value on every existing boltdb-shipper or tsdb period config. [ev-76a46c52508c] says nothing needs to change only when the prefix was never configured. Together, these make this a required operator step for the upgrade, so migration-required (mandatory work) is supported, and the statement and remediation match the upgrade guide's wording.
